notes: District of Columbia adopted NGSS directly in December 2013 (voted 8-1 by DC State Board of Education). DC was the ninth jurisdiction to adopt NGSS. DC provides a comprehensive Pre-K through Grade 12 science standards document. The standards are based on the National Research Council's Framework for K-12 Science Education.
adoption_details: DC State Board of Education adopted NGSS on December 18, 2013. Implementation began in 2016-17 school year.
assessment: DC Science Assessment is the District's statewide NGSS-aligned assessment, administered in grades 5 and 8. It is an online assessment focusing on sense-making and problem solving in science.
additional_info: DC requires four years of science for high school graduation. OSSE provides extensive professional development and implementation support for NGSS through their Teaching and Learning division.
